name: Millet Tabbouleh
ingredients: ½ cup uncooked foxtail or barnyard millet (about 1 cup cooked)
Dressing: 2 tsp olive oil, juice of 2 lemons, salt, pepper
steps: Cook the millet in 1 cup water for 12 minutes; fluff, spread out and cool completely.
Combine the parsley, mint, tomato, cucumber, spring onion and chickpeas.
Dress with the olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
note: A gluten-free take on tabbouleh; add the chickpeas to make it a main meal.
